# Essential Safety Measures Group

Essential Safety Measures Group (ESM Group) provides essential safety measures inspections, passive fire protection audits, AESMR preparation, system interface testing and related compliance advice for building owners and property teams in Melbourne and across Victoria, Australia.

## Core services
- Annual Essential Safety Measures Reports (AESMR): https://essentialsafetymeasuresgroup.com.au/services/annual-essential-safety-measures-report
- Quarterly means of egress inspections: https://essentialsafetymeasuresgroup.com.au/services/means-of-egress-inspections
- Passive fire protection audits: https://essentialsafetymeasuresgroup.com.au/services/passive-fire-protection-audits
- System Interface Testing (SIT) witnessing: https://essentialsafetymeasuresgroup.com.au/services/system-interface-testing
- Defect Liability Period audits: https://essentialsafetymeasuresgroup.com.au/services/defect-liability-period-audits
- Building notice advice: https://essentialsafetymeasuresgroup.com.au/services/building-notice-advice
- ESM regulatory training: https://essentialsafetymeasuresgroup.com.au/services/esm-regulatory-training
- Tailored ESM compliance support: https://essentialsafetymeasuresgroup.com.au/services/tailored-esm-compliance-support

## Important context
Requirements vary by building and are governed by approved building documents and Victorian legislation. Website content is general information and should not replace building-specific advice.
